requirements.name: Pre-Major
requirements.note: In order to qualify for admission into the Economics major, students must complete Economics 1, 2, and 10A with a UC grade-point average of 2.85 or above. No grade lower than a C in pre-major courses will be accepted. In addition, students must complete Economics 5 or PSTAT 120A and Math 2A-B or 3A-B or 34A-B with a grade of “C” or higher; the grades in these courses will not be used in computing the pre-major GPA but will apply to the overall major GPA. Econ 10A must be taken at UCSB.
requirements.note_zh: 准入门槛：Economics 1、2、10A 三门 UC GPA ≥ 2.85，且预备课成绩不得低于 C；另须完成 Economics 5 或 PSTAT 120A、Math 2A-B 或 3A-B 或 34A-B（成绩 ≥ C，这几门不计入预备 GPA 但计入专业总 GPA）。Econ 10A 必须在 UCSB 修。
